title: Session list: slower, calmer spinner for sessions in the background state
outcome: Session list: slower, calmer spinner for sessions in the background state
acceptance: In the session list, a session in the existing background state shows its spinner turning clearly slower than the spinner of an actively working session; sessions in other states keep their current animation, and no new labels or states are added.
Under prefers-reduced-motion the background spinner follows the existing reduced-motion behaviour, and a UI test covers both the background pace and the unchanged foreground pace.

`cd ui && npx tsc --noEmit` and `npx vitest run` are green. The look in the running UI is observed on the installed build after the next restart and reported to Greg; that observation does not block completion.

completion.summary: Delivered slower 3200ms background-only session spinner, static under reduced motion, with unchanged 850ms foreground/stopping/combined states and deterministic actual-Chrome checks. No acceptance evaluation exists.
